title: archive_signal failed in fix_signal post-resolution hook: a1000111-0613-4000-8000-000000000111
description: archive_signal: cannot archive 'a1000111-0613-4000-8000-000000000111' — status is 'in_progress' (must be 'resolved' or 'superseded'). The Archive Resolved Signal phase in fix_signal.skill.md is vestigial: it was designed when fix_signal also orchestrated start_spec and start_run, resulting in the signal being resolved within the same run. Now that fix_signal only performs pickup and event emission, the signal is in_progress at the end of the run and archive_signal always fails.
proposed_resolution: Investigate and manually archive the signal record. Additionally, update fix_signal.skill.md to remove or gate the Archive Resolved Signal phase, since signals are no longer resolved within the fix_signal run scope.
